name: GIR BO organization search (identity + financials list)
note: No key. Returns content[] with identity (inn, ogrn, kpp, okopf, okfs, okpo, okved2, region, address, statusCode) + bfo[] (financial-statement years). Then GET /nbo/organizations/{id}/bfo/ for the statement list; line items (balance sheet form1 / income statement form2) per period, RUB. Banks excluded.

name: RSMP — Unified SME Register (open bulk XML)
note: Monthly bulk ZIP (~2.25 GB) of chunked XML; XSD at structure-12052026.xsd. Per entity: ИННЮЛ (INN), ОГРН, НаимОрг, Регион, СвОКВЭД (OKVED), КатСубМСП (micro/small/medium), ССЧР (headcount), ДатаВклМСП. Large file — gate behind explicit env. May be Windows-1251.

name: FNS open data — per-INN tax info (example: SME register passport listing)
note: Lists open datasets (each a passport with a file.nalog.ru bulk URL): rsmp (SMEs), revexp (income/expense), paidtax (paid taxes), sshr (headcount), registerdisqualified. Keyed on INN.
